item.title: [−2] RBI's rate panel begins three-day meeting; 8 of 10 economists expect a hike to 5.50%
item.description:
The MPC meets October 5–7 with the decision due on the 7th. Most economists polled expect a 25-basis-point hike from 5.25%, the first since February 2023. Ongoing: hike expectations have built all week.

Real estate: headwind (−2) — Home loans get dearer

Why it matters: A hike lifts loan rates and G-Sec yields, hitting housing, vehicles and consumer credit, while supporting the rupee and lenders' margins at first. Markets have largely priced it; guidance on further hikes matters most.

Market gauges: Bond market (G-Secs) −2, Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Growth outlook −1, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
